dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Absence of discrete horizontal bands; instead, repetitive high-contrast pale crescentic fringes are visible on the median and greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent and sharp pale boundaries along the edges of folded primary and secondary feathers against dark centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A series of dense, rhythmic horizontal dark-and-light bars forming a scalloped pattern across the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse; the barring pattern is continuous from the crown through the nape and into the mantle with no linear color break.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive rhythmic horizontal barring covering the entire dorsal head, neck, and wing surface.
